# Echo

> Echo is an AI-powered journaling companion. It combines mood tracking, reflective prompts, and emotional insights to help people build a consistent journaling habit and improve their mental well-being.

## Docs

- [Guide & Insights](https://echojournal.life/guide): Articles on mindfulness, mental well-being, and getting the most out of Echo.

## Legal

- [Privacy Policy](https://echojournal.life/legal/privacy-policy)
- [Terms & Conditions](https://echojournal.life/legal/tnc)

## Notes

- Journaling entries, chat, mood data, and other in-app pages are private to signed-in users and are not indexed.
